people.name: Bashan
people.line: Region east of the Jordan, known for its fertility.

translations.web: Many bulls have surrounded me. Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.
translations.bsb: Many bulls surround me; strong bulls of Bashan encircle me.
translations.kjv: Many bulls have compassed me: strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.
